newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Briton found dead in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Briton found dead in Cambodia.

text.p: A British man was found dead in the Cambodian capital with a gun shot wound to the head, police said on Saturday.
The man, identified as John Allen, 40, from London, was found dead in his rented flat late on Friday, police said. He had been dead for a day or two, police said.
Police said they did not yet know why Allen had been shot or if he shot himself. Their investigation was continuing.
Friends of Allen said he had lived in Phnom Penh for two years but apparently had no job.
